# Component index

This system is closed-world: every legal component is enumerated in registries/components-index.json and every legal token in registries/tokens-index.json. Anything not in those registries is provably fabricated — do not emit it.

Every export comes from `@ds/react`. Full props tables: `../../llms-components.txt` or `../../docs/<Name>.md`.

- **Alert** (static) — Static status message rendered as a plain `<div>` with a tone-mapped ARIA role: interruptive tones (`danger`, `warning`) use `role="alert"` so assistive technology announces them immediately; calm tones (`info`, `success`) use the polite `role="status"`.
- **Badge** (static) — Static status label rendered as a plain `<span>`.
- **Button** (rac: Button) — Accessible push button built on react-aria-components `Button`.
- **Card** (static) — Static, purely presentational surface container (a plain `<div>`, no role).
- **CardBody** (static) — Card slot: main content region of a `Card`.
- **CardFooter** (static) — Card slot: trailing region of a `Card` (typically actions), separated from the content above by a hairline border.
- **CardHeader** (static) — Card slot: leading region of a `Card`, separated from the content below by a hairline border.
- **Checkbox** (rac: Checkbox) — Accessible checkbox built on react-aria-components `Checkbox`.
- **Dialog** (rac: Dialog) — Modal dialog built on react-aria-components `DialogTrigger` + `Modal` + `Dialog`.
- **IconButton** (rac: Button) — Icon-only push button built on react-aria-components `Button`.
- **Radio** (rac: Radio) — A single option inside a `RadioGroup`, built on react-aria-components `Radio`.
- **RadioGroup** (rac: RadioGroup) — A labeled group of mutually exclusive options built on react-aria-components `RadioGroup`.
- **Select** (rac: Select) — Accessible single-select built on react-aria-components `Select`, composing the RAC `Label`, `Button`, `SelectValue`, `Popover`, and `ListBox` parts internally behind a data-driven `items` API.
- **Switch** (rac: Switch) — Accessible on/off switch built on react-aria-components `Switch`.
- **Tab** (rac: Tab) — A single tab trigger inside `TabList`, built on react-aria-components `Tab`.
- **TabList** (rac: TabList) — The row of tab triggers inside `Tabs`, built on react-aria-components `TabList`.
- **TabPanel** (rac: TabPanel) — The content region for one tab, built on react-aria-components `TabPanel`.
- **Tabs** (rac: Tabs) — Container for a set of tabs, built on react-aria-components `Tabs`.
- **TextArea** (rac: TextField) — Accessible multi-line text input built on react-aria-components `TextField` with a `TextArea` element.
- **TextField** (rac: TextField) — Accessible single-line text input built on react-aria-components `TextField`, composing RAC `Label`, `Input`, `Text` (description), and `FieldError` internally — label association, description/error wiring (`aria-describedby`), and invalid-state announcement come from React Aria.
- **Tooltip** (rac: Tooltip) — Contextual text label shown near a trigger element on hover or keyboard focus, built on react-aria-components `TooltipTrigger` + `Tooltip`.
